cite.quote: Bets made before the start of the game on the Game-period Money Line market have action as long as at least 5 innings (or 4.5 innings if the Home team is winning) are completed. If a game is called (ended) before 9 innings (or 8.5 innings if the Home team wins) are complete, the score at the end of the last completed inning will be considered final, unless the game is called (ended) during the bottom half of one of these innings and the Home team has taken the lead. In this specific case, the actual score of the game will be used to grade the Game-period Money Line for pre-game bets.
cite.source: Pinnacle betting rules (published rules page) -- rule 3
